```
['build a MistralOCRConfig instance to configure Mistral OCR transformation', 'test the get_supported_ocr_params method to retrieve supported Mistral OCR parameters', 'create a transformed OCR request for Mistral using document dict and optional parameters', 'run validate_environment to set up Mistral OCR authorization headers with API key', 'summarize the transform_ocr_response method that parses Mistral OCR JSON into OCRResponse']

```
